title: Graders and inspectors
rule: The Director authorises graders (for timber) and inspectors (for other forest produce) to check quality and grade before export.
points: An authorisation is personal to the holder and expires on 31 December of the year it was issued (s.60(3)).
The Director may suspend or revoke an authorisation on at least 30 days' notice, on grounds of qualifications or experience, after considering the holder's representations (s.60(4)).
A grader or inspector may refuse to inspect produce they consider unfit for export, with reasons given (s.61(4)).
Handling and inspection charges are borne by the owner or exporter, who must provide the necessary labour and facilities (s.61(6)).
A person aggrieved by a grader's or inspector's decision may appeal to the Director within 30 days; a person aggrieved by the Director's decision may appeal to the High Court (s.61(7) to (8)).
checks: Reasons given for refusal or decision
